standard_prerequisites: Idempotents e_n and the ideals (e_n); directed colimits of modules and Hom-colimit adjunction
Mittag-Leffler exactness: Algebra, lemma-ML-exact-sequence (surjective transition systems give exact lim)
core_obligations: Inductively replace e_{n+1} by e_n + (1-e_n)e_{n+1} to arrange an ascending chain of idempotent ideals with I = union (e_n) = colim_n e_nR
Compute Hom_R(I, M) = lim_n Hom_R(e_nR, M) = lim_n e_nM (display computation of three terms)
Transition maps e_{n+1}M -> e_nM are multiplication by e_n, hence surjective; by the Algebra ML lemma Hom_R(I, -) is exact, i.e. I is projective
proof_roadmap: Normalize the generating idempotents into an ascending chain and express I as a colimit
Derive the natural isomorphism Hom_R(I, M) \cong lim e_nM
Apply the ML exactness lemma to the surjective tower and conclude projectivity
